headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.

headlines.title: 硅业分会：当前工业硅市场处于“供给收缩持续强化，市场进入筑底修复”的阶段

headlines.title_en: Silicon Industry Branch: Current industrial silicon market is in a phase of 'continued supply contraction and bottoming-out recovery'
headlines.summary_en: According to the Silicon Branch of the China Nonferrous Metals Industry Association, this week's industrial silicon market showed a divergence of 'futures rebounding with volatility, spot stabilizing after declines.' Boosted by industry policy expectations and supply-side reduction signals, futures prices briefly surged to around 8,450 yuan/ton, rebounding over 3% for the week; however, spot market gains lagged, with quotes holding steady this week, ending several weeks of consecutive declines. Supply-side contraction signals continue to strengthen, with market bottom characteristics gradually emerging.

headlines.title: 国家税务总局：对境外保险收益征税并非新政策 无需过度解读
headlines.summary: 近日，有报道称中国内地税务居民购买香港保险的收益被纳入征税范围，引发关注。就此，国家税务总局相关负责人指出，按照我国个人所得税法相关规定，中国税收居民需就全球所得履行纳税义务，境外保险收益也属于应纳税所得的范畴，这并非新政策，更不是专门针对香港保险市场，无需过度解读。

headlines.title_en: State Taxation Administration: Tax on overseas insurance income is not new policy, no need for overinterpretation
headlines.summary_en: Recently, reports that mainland Chinese tax residents' income from Hong Kong insurance policies is included in the taxable scope have drawn attention. In response, an official from the State Taxation Administration pointed out that, according to China's individual income tax law, Chinese tax residents are obligated to pay tax on global income, and overseas insurance income also falls within taxable income; this is not a new policy and is not specifically targeted at the Hong Kong insurance market, so there is no need for overinterpretation.

headlines.title: 八家硅料企业发布倡议 知情人士称或配套惩罚措施
headlines.summary: 八家光伏硅料企业签署《倡议书》，承诺不低于完全成本价销售，杜绝低价倾销，并将自查自纠、接受监管。 从知情人士处获悉，通威股份、协鑫科技、大全能源、新特能源、亚洲硅业、东方希望、青海丽豪、戈恩斯的确已于上海签署《倡议书》，共同承诺所有光伏产品销售价格（含招投标报价）均不得低于依据《光伏行业成本核算模型通则》核算的对应成本。其中一位参与《倡议书》签署的企业负责人回应记者，各大企业积极落实工信部、国家市场监督管理总局近期会议精神，“大家都是自愿倡议的。” 该人士还进一步透露，《倡议书》发布后或还会出台惩罚措施，加强自律。（21世纪经济报道）

headlines.title_en: Eight polysilicon companies issue initiative, insiders say punitive measures may follow
headlines.summary_en: Eight polysilicon companies signed an initiative pledging not to sell below full cost, to eliminate low-price dumping, and to conduct self-inspections and accept regulatory oversight. According to informed sources, Tongwei Co., GCL Tech, Daqo Energy, Xinjiang Xinte Energy, Asia Silicon, East Hope, Qinghai Lihao, and Gansu Gannes did sign the initiative in Shanghai, jointly committing that all photovoltaic product sales prices (including bidding quotes) will not be lower than the corresponding costs calculated under the 'Photovoltaic Industry Cost Accounting Model General Rules.' One company executive involved in the signing responded to reporters that major companies are actively implementing the recent meeting spirit of the MIIT and SAMR, with 'all signing voluntarily.' The source further revealed that punitive measures may be introduced after the initiative's release to strengthen self-discipline. (21st Century Business Herald)

headlines.title: 宇树科技王兴兴：生态黏性将使新品牌消费级机器人获客成本激增
headlines.summary: 宇树科技董事长、总经理兼首席技术官王兴兴表示，高性能通用机器人同时面向行业级和消费级的应用。对于行业级应用，电力、消防等已实现商业成熟应用的客户更倾向于具有成功落地案例的企业合作，未来在工业生产、医疗保健、应急救援等领域的应用也将由头部企业主导，市场头部效应显著。对于消费级应用，大量消费者优先考虑知名品牌的机器人产品，市场教育、品牌认知培养、品牌生态建设等都是竞争的关键环节，头部企业加速构建“硬件+软件+服务”三位一体的生态建设，逐步完善的生态黏性将使新品牌机器人的获客成本激增。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Unitree's Wang Xingxing: Ecosystem stickiness will surge customer acquisition costs for new brand consumer robots
headlines.summary_en: Wang Xingxing, Chairman, General Manager, and CTO of Unitree Robotics, stated that high-performance general-purpose robots target both industrial and consumer applications. For industrial applications, customers in sectors such as power and firefighting, which have achieved commercial maturity, prefer cooperating with companies with successful deployment cases; future applications in industrial production, healthcare, and emergency rescue will also be led by top players, with significant head effects. For consumer applications, many consumers prioritize robots from well-known brands; market education, brand awareness building, and brand ecosystem development are key competitive factors, with top companies accelerating the construction of a 'hardware + software + service' integrated ecosystem, and gradually improved ecosystem stickiness will sharply raise customer acquisition costs for new-brand robots. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.summary: 1，整体走势：沪指全天震荡走强，创业板指冲高回落。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市约2900股飘红，今日成交2.68万亿。截止收盘沪指涨1.02%，深成指涨1.42%，创业板指涨1.35%。 2，行业板块：医药医疗、PCB、CPO、半导体芯片等板块涨幅居前，数字货币、跨境支付、软件开发、游戏等板块跌幅居前。 3，热门概念：创新药、CRO概念股爆发，百花医药4连板，药康生物、泓博医药等十余股涨停。PCB概念股延续强势，一博科技、宝鼎科技、生益科技等多股涨停。半导体芯片表现活跃，锴威特、有研新材、先导基电等涨停。

headlines.title_en: A-share market close: All three indices rise over 1%, innovative drugs and PCB concept stocks rally
headlines.summary_en: 1, Overall trend: The Shanghai index strengthened throughout the day, while the ChiNext Index surged then pulled back. Advancers outnumbered decliners, with about 2,900 stocks rising across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets, and turnover reached 2.68 trillion yuan. At the close, the Shanghai Composite rose 1.02%, the Shenzhen Component rose 1.42%, and the ChiNext rose 1.35%. 2, Sectors: Pharmaceuticals and healthcare, PCB, CPO, and semiconductor chips led gains, while digital currency, cross-border payments, software development, and gaming led declines. 3, Hot concepts: Innovative drugs and CRO concepts surged, with Baihua Medicine hitting four consecutive limit-ups and more than ten stocks including Yaokang Biotech and Hongbo Medicine hitting limit-up. PCB concepts remained strong, with multiple stocks including Yibo Tech, Baoding Tech, and Shengyi Tech hitting limit-up. Semiconductor chips were active, with stocks like Kaiwei Te, Youyan New Materials, and Xiandao Jidian hitting limit-up.

headlines.title: 群核科技上市三个月股价跌回发行价，资本市场为何不买账？
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月7日讯，经查，财通证券股份有限公司存在经纪业务在内部制度建设、账户监测预警处理、权限管理等方面存在不足。自营业务在部门及岗位职能独立、交易指令审核、询价活动监测、合规人员派驻、稽核工作等方面存在不足。证监会浙江监管局决定对财通证券股份有限公司采取出具警示函的行政监督管理措施，并记入证券期货市场诚信档案。

headlines.title: 华为哈勃等入股极顶数创
headlines.summary: 据天眼查，极顶数创（上海）科技有限公司发生工商变更，新增华为旗下深圳哈勃科技投资合伙企业（有限合伙）、张永涛等为股东，同时，注册资本由约350.8万人民币增至约448.2万人民币。该公司成立于2025年2月，法定代表人为嵇盼，经营范围包括人工智能应用软件开发、人工智能理论与算法软件开发、工业互联网数据服务、信息系统集成服务等。

headlines.title_en: Huawei Hubble and others invest in Jiding Shuchuang
headlines.summary_en: According to Tianyancha, Jiding Shuchuang (Shanghai) Technology Co., Ltd. has undergone business registration changes, adding Huawei-affiliated Shenzhen Hubble Technology Investment Partnership (Limited Partnership), Zhang Yongtao, and others as shareholders, while registered capital increased from approximately 3.508 million yuan to approximately 4.482 million yuan. The company was established in February 2025, with legal representative Ji Pan, and its business scope includes AI application software development, AI theory and algorithm software development, industrial internet data services, and information system integration services.

headlines.title: 中汽协：上半年汽车整车出口530.7万辆，同比增长52.8%
headlines.summary: 据中国汽车工业协会整理的海关总署数据显示，2026年6月，汽车整车出口106.9万辆，环比增长8.2%，同比增长72.7%，出口金额达182.3亿美元，环比增长9.1%，同比增长69.6%。

headlines.title_en: China Association of Automobile Manufacturers: Vehicle exports totaled 5.307 million units in H1, up 52.8% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: According to data from the General Administration of Customs compiled by the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers, in June 2026, complete vehicle exports totaled 1.069 million units, up 8.2% month-on-month and 72.7% year-on-year, with an export value of $18.23 billion, up 9.1% month-on-month and 69.6% year-on-year.

headlines.title_en: Fudan-Zhangjiang: to hold 2026 interim results briefing on August 17
headlines.summary_en: Fudan Zhangjiang announced that it plans to hold its 2026 semi-annual results briefing on August 17, 2026, from 14:00-15:00 at the Shanghai Stock Exchange Roadshow Center, in an online interactive format. Attendees include Chairman Zhao Dajun, General Manager Xue Yan, and others. Investors can log in to the Shanghai Stock Exchange Roadshow Center during this period to participate online, or submit questions via the center or the company's email from August 10 to August 14, before 16:00, which will be addressed during the session.

headlines.title: 国家外汇局：截止7月末我国外汇储备规模为34188亿美元，升幅0.07%
headlines.summary: 国家外汇管理局统计数据显示，截至2026年7月末，我国外汇储备规模为34188亿美元，较6月末上升25亿美元，升幅为0.07%。 2026年7月，受全球宏观形势、主要经济体货币政策等因素影响，美元指数下跌，全球主要金融资产价格涨跌互现。汇率折算和资产价格变化等因素综合作用，当月外汇储备规模上升。我国经济呈现动能向新、结构向优的发展态势，展现出强大韧性和活力，有利于外汇储备规模保持基本稳定。

headlines.title_en: State Administration of Foreign Exchange: as of end-July, China's foreign exchange reserves stand at $3.4188 trillion, up 0.07%
headlines.summary_en: According to data from the State Administration of Foreign Exchange, as of the end of July 2026, China's foreign exchange reserves stood at $3,418.8 billion, up $2.5 billion from the end of June, an increase of 0.07%. In July 2026, influenced by global macroeconomic conditions and monetary policies of major economies, the U.S. dollar index fell, while prices of major global financial assets were mixed. Combined effects of exchange rate translation and asset price changes led to a rise in foreign exchange reserves for the month. China's economy is showing a trend of new momentum and improved structure, demonstrating strong resilience and vitality, which is conducive to maintaining overall stability in the scale of foreign exchange reserves.

headlines.title: 恒生指数：推出恒生A股铜产业指数
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月7日讯，恒生指数公司公告，公司今天推出恒生A股铜产业指数。此指数反映A股从事铜行业产业链的公司之表现，涵盖上游采矿活动及部份下游应用领域的内地上市公司。

headlines.title_en: Hang Seng Index: launches Hang Seng A-share Copper Industry Index
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data August 7 - Hang Seng Indexes Company announced that it launched the Hang Seng A-Share Copper Industry Index today. This index reflects the performance of A-share companies in the copper industry chain, covering mainland listed companies in upstream mining activities and parts of downstream applications.
